projects.title: CleryDart
projects.description: CleryDart is a visualization of data from Dartmouth College's Daily Crime Log.   I developed the campus safety web application after realizing that daily campus crime statistics were not accessible to students.  The program takes input from a spreadsheet and maps it on OpenStreetMap using the coordinates of Dartmouth College buildings.  Created with JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, and the Amazon Web Services Suite.  Utilized GitHub for version control, and Folium & OpenStreetMap for mapping.  Covered by NPR on August 26, 2014.
